Game Overview

In Squirrel Steps, the core idea is straightforward: quick, browser-based gameplay.

How to Play

The moment-to-moment gameplay in Squirrel Steps is easy to pick up. Jump in, follow the on-screen goal, and aim to beat your own best result each run.

Related FAQs

What is Squirrel Steps?

Squirrel Steps is a free puzzle game you can play instantly in your browser, with no download required.

Is Squirrel Steps free to play?

Yes, Squirrel Steps is completely free to play in your browser on GameBurst — no download or installation needed.
